main.description: Writes a dev.knotless.repo record under the name given in the account logged in to this appview's web pages, as `knotless repo create` does: public unless asked for private, naming the runners the appview offers for new repositories, and with no branches until the first push. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account. Clients holding their own session write the record themselves.

errors.description: The name is not one a repository can have, or the account has a repository by it already.
errors.name: InvalidRequest

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

defaultBranch.description: The branch its HEAD names, without refs/heads/: main when absent.

description.description: What the repository is, shown under its name.

name.description: The repository's name, its record key.

private.description: Whether to make it private, as `knotless repo create --private` does: a space of its own on the account's PDS, which only its members read, its runners among them. Public when absent.

description: Creates a repository in the account logged in to this appview's pages.
